title: Carbon Dioxide and Methane Emissions from Peat Soil in an Undrained Tropical Peat Swamp Forest

authorization.user_request: you should upload it to tidbrepo

source_verification.basis: Stored complete page text from the original checksummed PDF, cross-checked against author-posted full text Table 3 and the publisher abstract.
source_verification.source_locator: Table 3, Simple ave., CH4, Non-trenched (n=9)*; original PDF p. 14. Site/methods pp. 5–7; discussion pp. 13–14.

evidence_quotes: Annual Cumulative Soil CO 2 and CH 4 Emissions (g C m -2 y-1; mean ± 1 SD)
source_verification.context: Undrained selectively logged Alan Batu peat-swamp forest, conserved as Maludam National Park since 2000; automated soil chambers, not ecosystem-scale flux; non-trenched plots; October 2015–September 2017 annual integrations with gap filling.

statistic: Simple mean annual flux, one standard deviation; n=9 plots after excluding one outlier.
conversion_formula: value × (16/12) × 10 / 365; same positive factor applied to SD
conversion_assumptions: CH4 carbon mass to methane mass uses 16/12.
g m^-2 to kg ha^-1 uses 10.
Annual to daily uses the project policy 365-day convention; this is a standardized annual daily equivalent, not an independently measured daily mean.
Stored mean and SD use three significant figures, matching source precision.
tier_rationale: Tier 2 crosswalk for country-specific Malaysian field evidence, consistent with existing peat-land entries; not a paper-reported IPCC tier.
excluded_alternative_statistics: These are not additional independent factors in this authorized upload.
